column3: {text_effect:4}Uhnn... Ohh...{end_wait}
You're staying here.\nBoth of you.{end_wait}
One word and\nhe gets hurt!{end_wait}
They're back!\nWhy won't they leave?{end_wait}
Then we fight again.\nNo more running.{end_wait}
Get them!\nDon't let them escape!{end_wait}
They...{pause_20_skippable} beat us...{end_wait}
I thought we were\ngoing to die.{end_wait}
It's over. We won.{end_wait}
I'll fetch the mayor.\nKeep an eye on them.{end_wait}
All that trouble,\nand for what?{end_wait}
You robbed people\nduring the eruption.{page_break}Some of them\nhad lost everything.{end_wait}
I told you we should\nhave left days ago.{end_wait}
You were caught.\nThat's what matters.{end_wait}
So this is where\nthey hid everything.{end_wait}
Mayor, we found\nthe thieves.{end_wait}
The inn took you in.{page_break}And you repaid this town\nby stealing from it.{end_wait}
Their doors were open!{page_break}We thought{em_dash}Ow!\nAll right!{end_wait}
I was hungry.\nI know it's no excuse.{end_wait}
What happens to them now?{end_wait}
They'll be held\nuntil we decide.{page_break}The law still applies,\neven after a disaster.{end_wait}
Wake up!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}!\nI'll remember you!{end_wait}
Take them to the jail.{end_wait}
You brought them in.\nThank you.{end_wait}
We needed some good news.{end_wait}
Let's count what's here.{end_wait}
The mayor's urn...\nThey took that too.{end_wait}
Mayor, is this\nyour family's urn?{end_wait}
These ashes are\nall I have left.{page_break}Thank you for\nbringing them home.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3} took back the\nShaman's Rod.{end_wait}
People here feared me.\nSome still helped.{page_break}I won't forget either.\nTake care.{end_wait}
We should get moving.\nThere's a long road ahead.{end_wait}
I can sleep again.{page_break}I thought they'd come\nfor my stone.{end_wait}
At least our stone\nis still here.{end_wait}
Everyone wants my rock!{page_break}I'm not letting it\nout of my sight.{end_wait}
Maybe it isn't worth\nanything after all.{end_wait}
Were they from Lunpa?{end_now}
Dodonpa runs Lunpa now.{page_break}His men won't be pleased\nabout these arrests.{end_wait}
Donpa kept his father's\nmen in line.{page_break}Dodonpa doesn't\nseem to care.{end_wait}
Father worries Lunpa's\nmen will come for them.{page_break}Will you help us\nif they do?{end_wait}
Lunpa changed when\nDodonpa took charge.{end_wait}
Father hasn't slept\nmuch lately.{end_wait}
They hid the loot\nin the inn's loft.{page_break}Some was buried\nnear the graves.{end_wait}
Nothing was taken\nfrom our house.{end_wait}
We had nothing\nworth taking.{page_break}I suppose that's\none kind of luck.{end_wait}
I'd like to own\nsomething valuable.{end_wait}
You helped us,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
We promised a reward.\nPlease accept it.{end_wait}
Received {argument_item_name:2}.{end_wait}
You're carrying too much,\n{actor_name:1}.{page_break}Come back when you've\nmade room.{end_wait}
Are you heading beyond\nthe Goma Range?{end_now}
The Goma cave lies\nnortheast of here.{page_break}Bilibin is beyond it.\nWatch your footing.{end_wait}
The southern bridge\nis still out.{end_wait}
You brought back\nour family urn.{page_break}Thank you.{end_wait}
You caught those thieves?{end_now}
I judged you too quickly.\nI'm sorry.{end_wait}
My father said\nyou caught them.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3} can understand\nanimals.{page_break}They notice things\nwe overlook.{end_wait}
The Goma cave is rough.\nTake care in there.{end_wait}
Our family's urn\nis back where it belongs.{end_wait}
I want to be strong\nwhen I grow up.{page_break}Strong enough\nto help someone.{end_wait}
I wish I could fly.{page_break}I'd see the world\nbeyond these hills.{end_wait}
Our stolen weapons\nwere found by the graves.{page_break}They're rusted.\nI'll have to mend them.{end_wait}
My weapons were buried\nnear the cemetery.{page_break}I'll need to clean\nevery one of them.{end_wait}
Take supplies before\nyou enter Goma cave.{end_wait}
It must be cold\nup in Imil.{end_wait}
The bridge is broken.\nKalay feels far away.{end_wait}
Why is everyone\nin such a hurry?{end_wait}
Those guests were thieves.\nI let them stay here.{end_wait}
They hid everything\nabove our heads.{page_break}I should've checked\nthe loft sooner.{end_wait}
I have bones left from\ndinner. Nothing else to\nspare. Want some?{end_now}
Really? Take what you\nwant.{end_wait}
I don't blame you. Nobody\nlives on bones alone.{end_wait}
I never guessed\nwhat our guests were.{page_break}They paid on time.\nI didn't ask questions.{end_wait}
I suspected something.\nI said nothing.{end_wait}
The stew smells good.{page_break}Perhaps one taste\nwouldn't hurt.{end_wait}
That's quite a load.\nCan you carry it all?{end_wait}
What? You want more\nbones?{end_now}
Go ahead... Take what\nyou need.{end_wait}
I don't blame you.{page_break}Only a dog would be\nhappy with nothing but\nbones.{end_wait}
My husband says the cat\nate the treasure. I don't\nbelieve him anymore.{end_wait}
He really likes bones.\nHmm... I wonder what he's\nbeen eating before this.{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"History of Vault, Vol 1"{page_break}The book says Vault was
named for what it was:
a place to hide.{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Gems of Angara."{page_break}It says nothing about
the rock on the table.
Maybe it's better so.{end_wait}
